implementation.name: original-v4-09-rack-end-erosion
implementation.scope: The hull stays fixed. The growing region is a conservative possible-person reach set, not an observed person or a predicted walking trajectory. Source clearances and walking-speed bound come from the chapter; playback is not real time.
implementation.question: What does an aging free-space claim still certify?

purpose: Expand the source possible-person reach set and shrink the actual ahead certificate together, with a stationary hull and an immutable capture epoch.
storyboard: Let the possible reach set grow
Erode most of the ahead certificate
guard: Never animate a known human trajectory or move the hull in this fixed-hull example. Reach uncertainty grows at the canonical speed bound; abreast depth is zero from capture and global publication does not renew evidence.
